h1: How to Choose a Lab-Grown Diamond Necklace: Style, Length and Budget

content.text: The right lab-grown diamond necklace depends on three things: the style of pendant, where you want the chain to sit and how much you plan to spend. A solitaire pendant is a versatile choice for everyday wear; a Y-shaped necklace creates a longer line at the neckline; and a symbolic design can make a more personal present.

At I Want Jewels, the necklace collection includes lab-grown diamond designs listed from €149 to €349. Many styles are listed at €149, with selected designs at €199 and more elaborate options at €299 or €349. Check each product page for its current price, chain measurement, pendant dimensions, finish options and availability.

Quick answer: For a simple everyday diamond necklace, compare the Aurora Singola, listed at €149. For an elongated silhouette, consider the Aurora Y, also listed at €149. For a floral pendant, see the Fiorella, listed at €149. Choose by the design you will wear most, then check that necklace’s actual chain length and pendant measurements.

sections.heading: Choose a Necklace for How You Will Wear It

content.text: For everyday wear

Look for a design that feels comfortable with the clothes you wear most often. A compact pendant can work with shirts, blouses, knitwear and simple dresses. A solitaire or understated pendant is also easier to pair with other jewellery than a large, highly decorative design.

The [Aurora Singola](/products/iwjnk0004) is a solitaire-style option. The [Renata](/products/iwjnk0007) has a ring-inspired circular design. Both are listed at €149; check their product pages for the full specifications.
For open necklines

A V-neck, scoop neck or open collar gives a pendant space to sit visibly. A Y-shaped necklace can follow the vertical line of a V-neck, while a solitaire or other central pendant can provide a simple focal point.

The [Aurora Y](/products/iwjnk0005) is one option for this look. Its listed chain length is 18 inches. Check the size and measurement details on any necklace you are considering, since the fit and pendant position can vary by design and wearer.
For a more decorative look

A motif adds character without needing a large stone. The floral [Fiorella](/products/iwjnk0008) and star-inspired [Stella](/products/iwjnk0002) offer alternatives to a traditional solitaire. Compare their shape and pendant measurements in the product photographs and specifications.
For layering

If you plan to wear a necklace with other chains, check the length of each piece and how its pendant sits. Different chain lengths help separate the pendants visually. A simple chain can sit above a central pendant, while a longer necklace can add another layer below it.

Before buying, check whether the chosen necklace is offered in a length that will work with your existing pieces. Do not assume that every design has an extender or multiple length options; confirm this on its product page.

sections.heading: How to Choose the Right Necklace Length

content.text: Necklace length affects where the chain and pendant sit, but the final position also depends on body proportions, neck size, pendant design and clothing. The measurements below are general guides:

rows: 16 inches / 41 cm
Close to the base of the neck
Crew necks, open collars and short layers
18 inches / 46 cm
Around the collarbone on many wearers
Everyday tops, blouses and many open necklines
20 inches / 51 cm
Lower on the chest
Higher necklines or longer necklace layers

content.text: These are approximate positions, not guarantees. If you already own a necklace that fits well, measure it and compare the result with the product measurement. If you are buying a gift, check whether the recipient tends to wear close-fitting chains or longer pendants.

Many I Want Jewels necklace listings show an 18-inch chain, but check the specific product page before choosing. For example, the [Aurora Y product details](/products/iwjnk0005) list its chain measurement.

I Want Jewels’ current necklace collection includes products at several price points. Use your budget to narrow your choices, then compare design, measurements and diamond details rather than choosing by price alone.

sections.heading: Check the Diamond and Product Details

content.text: A necklace’s total carat weight tells you the combined weight of its diamonds; it does not, on its own, show exactly how large the pendant will look. Stone arrangement, pendant dimensions and the overall design also affect its appearance.
Before you buy, review:

items: The listed diamond type and total carat weight.
The pendant’s height and width in millimetres.
The chain length stated for that product.
The metal and finish options available.
The product photographs, including close-up images.
The current price, availability and delivery details.

content.text: The necklace category describes the range as lab-grown diamond jewellery crafted in 925 sterling silver, with finish details shown on individual product pages. Check the exact listing for the material and finish of the piece you are choosing.

sections.heading: Choosing a Necklace as a Gift

content.text: A necklace can be a practical gift when you do not know someone’s ring size. To make the choice more personal, consider the jewellery she already wears: does she prefer simple pendants, floral motifs, symbolic shapes or layered chains? Also check which metal finish she tends to choose.

If you are unsure about her preferred chain length, choose a style whose listed length resembles a necklace she already wears. Confirm the product’s size and availability before ordering. For more gift ideas across jewellery types, browse the [jewellery gifts guide](/resources/jewellery-gift-guides/jewellery-gifts-for-her).

sections.heading: Find a Necklace That Suits Your Style

items.question: How do I choose a lab-grown diamond necklace?
items.answer: Choose a design that suits how you plan to wear it, check where its chain will sit, and compare the product’s dimensions and diamond details against your budget. Verify the exact specifications on the product page.

items.question: What necklace length is best for everyday wear?
items.answer: An 18-inch chain is a common everyday length and sits around the collarbone on many wearers. The exact position depends on the person and the pendant. Check the listed chain measurement before buying.

items.question: What is the difference between a solitaire and a Y-shaped necklace?
items.answer: A solitaire necklace centres attention on one pendant or diamond. A Y-shaped necklace continues below the chain into a vertical form, creating a longer line down the neckline. The best choice depends on the look you prefer and the neckline you wear.

items.question: Are lab-grown diamonds real diamonds?
items.answer: Lab-grown diamonds are diamonds created in a laboratory rather than formed underground. Check each product page for confirmation of the stone type and its listed details.

items.question: How much does a lab-grown diamond necklace cost at I Want Jewels?
items.answer: The necklace category currently includes styles listed from €149 to €349. Prices can change, so check the live category and product pages before purchasing.
